<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ValidationRule xmlns="http://soap.sforce.com/2006/04/metadata">
    <fullName>Payload_Class_Required</fullName>
    <active>true</active>
    <description>Enter the Payload Class when Payload Source is Apex Class.</description>
    <errorConditionFormula>AND(ISPICKVAL(Payload_Source__c, "Apex Class"), ISBLANK(Payload_Class__c))</errorConditionFormula>
    <errorMessage>Enter the Payload Class when Payload Source is Apex Class.</errorMessage>
</ValidationRule>
